scope: One exact round950-to951 A/B plus v4 rebuild control; referee does not run elimination.

index_semantics.bucket_order: numeric frequency ascending; natural Mono ascending inside every committed bucket
index_semantics.update: one checked bump per non-target nonzero row occurrence in every newly materialized vector
index_semantics.dirty_commit: one folded remove from committed frequency and one add at final frequency for each touched row
index_semantics.map_index_equality: the bump return/new index count equals the authoritative exposed_frequency count after every occurrence
index_semantics.flatten_guard: complete census and every adjacent (frequency,Mono) pair is strictly ascending
index_semantics.rank_hash_encoding: u32 frequency little-endian, then Mono len byte, then 12 ids bytes
index_semantics.process_persistence: index persists between rounds in one process
index_semantics.resume: rebuild index from the complete authoritative vector cache; no checkpoint/cache schema change

required_static_source_guards: checked u32 initial conversion and checked increment
strict initial and committed bucket order
removal subset and addition collision rejection
entry/bucket census before and after commit
FNV lookup shards do not choose rank order
checkpoint and vector-cache persistence functions byte-identical to v3
non-v4/mode mismatch fails closed or executes sealed v3 path

promotion_thresholds_frozen_before_resul.meaning: v4 elapsed <= 0.95*v3 and saves >=0.5s; v3 ordered_sort/(v4 commit+flatten) >=1.5
